summary.text: Edlira Sako is the Democratic candidate for Michigan State Senate District 24 in the November 3, 2026 general election, having advanced from the August 4 Democratic primary.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as an immigrant and mother who works as a reading interventionist and is pursuing a master's degree in counseling.

paragraphs.text: In a Ballotpedia survey, Sako said she is pursuing a master's degree in counseling at Wayne State University while working full-time as a reading interventionist at Michigan Collegiate Elementary School in Roseville.
She said she moved to the United States more than 14 years ago and has lived in Macomb County since.

Sako listed three key messages: putting people first on housing, grocery, utility and health care costs; strengthening public schools, including support for teachers and mental health resources; and opportunity through hard work.
